description: This source file extends the NodeAppModel class with asynchronous methods to resolve canvas host URLs, normalize URLs for trust comparison, handle UI connection states, and perform TCP probing for a specific URL. It incorporates functionality specific to iOS platform context and network interactions within the application.

classes.name: A2UIReadyState
classes.description: Enumeration representing the readiness state of the A2 UI, with cases for ready, host not configured, and host unavailable.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: A class extended with asynchronous methods for resolving host URLs, managing UI state, and network probing related to the Canvas UI in an iOS application.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the Canvas host URL, returning nil if the URL is invalid, empty, or a loopback host.

methods.name: _test_resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Test method that calls resolveA2UIHostURL for testing purposes.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the A2 UI host URL, appending a specific path and query parameters.

methods.name: normalizeURLForTrustComparison
methods.description: Normalizes a URL string by removing fragments and lowercasing scheme and host for trust comparison.

methods.name: showA2UIOnConnectIfNeeded
methods.description: Shows the default canvas UI when connected, running on the main thread.

methods.name: ensureA2UIReadyWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Ensures the A2 UI is ready, attempting to refresh capabilities if necessary, and returns the current readiness state.

methods.name: showLocalCanvasOnDisconnect
methods.description: Resets the UI to show the default canvas when disconnected.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the A2 UI host URL, refreshing node capabilities if needed.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the Canvas host URL, refreshing capabilities if needed.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Performs a TCP probe to the URL's host and port with a specified timeout.
